name: The model gets its own reasoning back
prose: every request to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint carries each earlier assistant message's reasoning back as `reasoning_content`, beside its text and tool calls, so a model that thinks between tool calls (MiMo, GLM-5, Kimi, DeepSeek) keeps its plan from one step to the next instead of re-deriving it or planning everything up front; an endpoint that rejects the field is sent the history without it, once learned.
invariant: Each earlier assistant message's reasoning goes back to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint as reasoning_content on every later request, until that endpoint rejects the field.
